**Machine Learning and Deep Learning Path with Python**

| 1 | EDX2045 | Introduction to Python and Programming for Data Science and Machine Learning | edx | Foundational Python programming skills |
| 2 | EDX2052 | Introduction to Data Science with Python | edx | Hands-on experience with Python for data science challenges |
| 3 | EDX342 | Deep Learning with Python and PyTorch | edx | Introduction to deep learning with PyTorch |
| 4 | EDX2697 | Deep Learning Essentials | edx | Fundamentals of deep learning, including neural networks and terminology |
| 5 | EDX3425 | Data Science with Python | edx | Practical application of data science and analysis techniques |
| 6 | EDX342 | Deep Learning with Python and PyTorch | edx | Building and training deep neural networks with PyTorch |
| 7 | EDX3425 | Data Science with Python | edx | Applying data science and analysis techniques to real-world problems |
| 8 | EDX342 | Deep Learning with Python and PyTorch | edx | Advanced deep learning topics, including transfer learning and convolutional neural networks |
| 9 | EDX3425 | Data Science with Python | edx | Final project applying data science and analysis techniques to a real-world problem |

This path starts with foundational Python programming skills (EDX2045) and hands-on experience with Python for data science challenges (EDX2052). The learner then progresses to introduction to deep learning with PyTorch (EDX342), followed by fundamentals of deep learning, including neural networks and terminology (EDX2697). The path continues with practical application of data science and analysis techniques (EDX3425) and building and training deep neural networks with PyTorch (EDX342). The learner then applies data science and analysis techniques to real-world problems (EDX3425) and finally, applies advanced deep learning topics, including transfer learning and convolutional neural networks (EDX342). The path concludes with a final project applying data science and analysis techniques to a real-world problem (EDX3425).

Note: The available courses do not fully cover the request for a 12-month path, but the above path covers the most relevant and essential courses for a machine learning and deep learning path with Python.
